title: MatGPTQ: Efficient and Accurate Inference over Nested Quantized Models
abstract: arXiv:2602.03537v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Matryoshka Quantization (MatQuant), Any-Precision-LLM (AP) and AnyBCQ (AB) are recent quantization approaches showing that a single integer-quantized model can be served across multiple precisions. In this paradigm, lower-precision models are extracted from a higher-precision model by simply reading fewer bits of the weights. This enables a single checkpoint to cover a wide range of memory and latency budgets, but makes both quantization and efficient execution substantially harder. Existing methods rely on expensive quantization-aware training (QAT) or gradient-based post-training quantization (PTQ) rather than fast one-shot PTQ, and offer limited system support: dedicated kernels are either missing or restricted to single- or small-batch decoding. translated_title: MatGPTQ：嵌套量化模型上的高效且精确推理
translated_abstract: Matryoshka量化（MatQuant）、Any-Precision-LLM（AP）和AnyBCQ（AB）是近期的量化方法，它们表明单个整数量化模型可以以多种精度提供服务。在这种范式下，低精度模型只需通过读取权重的更少比特，即可从高精度模型中提取出来。这使得单个模型检查点能够覆盖广泛的内存和延迟预算范围，但同时也使量化和高效执行变得更加困难。现有方法依赖于昂贵的量化感知训练（QAT）或基于梯度的训练后量化（PTQ），而非快速的一次性PTQ，且系统支持有限：专用内核要么缺失，要么仅限于单批次或小批次解码。我们通过训练后Matryoshka量化方法来解决这些限制，这是一个用于嵌套模型量化与推理的端到端流水线。MatGPTQ将Matryoshka量化（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MatGPTQ提出了一种端到端的训练后Matryoshka嵌套量化流水线，无需昂贵的量化感知训练即可实现多精度嵌套量化模型的高效且准确的推理。
en_tdlr: MatGPTQ introduces an end-to-end post-training Matryoshka quantization pipeline that enables efficient and accurate inference over nested multi-precision quantized models without costly quantization-aware training.
